digest.component_or_area: LLM model capabilities and parameter handling
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table has one entry (us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7) but the DEFAULT_MODEL claude-opus-4-8 is unguarded, causing hard failures when temperature is configured on this model family.

Both us. and global. Bedrock profile prefixes for claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 reject temperature and top_p parameters with ValidationException, but the override table keys on full model id and covers only one prefix variant.

The Anthropic direct adapter (models/anthropic.py:641) silently drops unsupported sampling parameters and logs a warning, while the Bedrock adapter has no such drop and returns HTTP 400, creating two symptoms of one defect.

Pass-2 code-review verification pins temperature=0 for determinism (code-review.yaml:155) but runs on claude-opus-4-8 which rejects explicit non-default temperature values, causing unintended resampling in production.

The override table's bare model ids must cover both anthropic: prefixed and bedrock us./global. prefixed variants to prevent the same model from being guarded in one provider path but unguarded in another.
